title: Productivity, presentation, and collaboration
question: How have authoring and collaboration tools reshaped schoolwork and education, and which assumptions about teaching and learning do they reinforce?

title: Educational media and multimedia creation
question: How do media forms shape whose knowledge is represented and how learners interpret, communicate, and create meaning?

title: Distance and online learning
question: How have correspondence, broadcast, and learning management systems reshaped access, pedagogy, and educational relationships?

title: The web, social media, and networks
question: How have networked technologies reshaped what counts as knowledge and learning and the roles of learners and educators?

title: Assistive technologies and accessible learning
question: How do assistive technologies and accessible design reflect competing understandings of disability, participation, and independence?

title: Open resources and open education
question: How do open resources and practices redistribute access, authority, and participation in educational knowledge creation?

title: Coding, robotics, and makerspaces
question: How do making and programming enact theories of learning, and under what conditions do they support meaningful inquiry?

title: Games, simulations, and immersive learning
question: What assumptions about motivation and learning underpin these environments, and how does learning transfer beyond them?

title: Assessment and feedback technologies
question: How do assessment systems define and value learning, and what are the consequences for feedback and student agency?

title: Generative AI in education
question: How does generative AI challenge or reinforce educational assumptions about knowledge, authorship, expertise, and the purposes of learning?
